description: This file defines the MockPersistentReportingStore class, a mock implementation of ReportingCache::PersistentReportingStore used for testing. It includes command structures, methods for managing stored reporting endpoints and groups, and utilities for verifying command sequences.

classes.name: MockPersistentReportingStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of ReportingCache::PersistentReportingStore for testing purposes, simulating command handling and stored clients.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command to be executed on the mock store, including types for loading, adding, updating, deleting endpoints and groups, and flushing.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Loads reporting clients and executes the provided callback.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint to the store.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint group to the store.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the current commands to storage.

methods.name: SetPrestoredClients
methods.description: Sets pre-existing clients and groups for testing.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, optionally simulating success or failure.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies that the executed command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: CountCommands
methods.description: Counts the number of commands of a specific type.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns all commands executed so far.

methods.name: StoredEndpointsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of stored endpoints.

methods.name: StoredEndpointGroupsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of stored endpoint groups.
